revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a utility-room passage with cabinets, conduits, inspection access panels, and large neutral floor and wall tiles. Moderate backlight balanced by usable foreground fill. Right-oblique view, medium-wide framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A young adult with medium build wearing a light work shirt and dark cargo trousers in brown and cream tones is kneeling beside a low object and reaching forward; knee and shin support clearly visible, torso upright and not lying down. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, with a column or partition partly framing one side of the image. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
